### Data Cleaning

```{r}
# load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(tidymodels)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
# load data
data_train <- read.csv("data-train.csv")
data_test  <- read.csv("data-test.csv")

#compute central moments
cleaned_data_train <- data_train |>
  mutate(
    mean = R_moment_1,
    var  = R_moment_2 - R_moment_1^2,   # Var = E[X^2] - (E[X])^2
    sd   = sqrt(var),
    c3   = R_moment_3 - mean^3 - 3*mean*R_moment_2 + 3*(mean^2)*R_moment_1,   # expanded via linearity of E
    c4   = R_moment_4 - 4*R_moment_1*R_moment_3 + 6*R_moment_1^2*R_moment_2 - 3*R_moment_1^4,
    skew = c3 / sd^3,
    kurt = c4 / sd^4
  ) |>
  select(St, Re, Fr, mean, sd, skew, kurt)

# NEW: sanity checks (all should be TRUE)
stopifnot(all(cleaned_data_train$sd > 0),
          all(cleaned_data_train$skew > 0),
          all(cleaned_data_train$kurt >= 1))
```

```{r}
# transform predictors (applied identically to train + test)
transform_preds <- function(df) {
  df |>
    mutate(
      Fr_cat = factor(Fr, levels = c(Inf, 0.3, 0.052),
                      labels = c("none", "moderate", "strong")),
      Re_cat = factor(Re, levels = c(90, 224, 398)),
      log_St = log(St)   # NEW (optional): spreads out St values above 1
    )
}

cleaned_data_train <- transform_preds(cleaned_data_train)
cleaned_data_test  <- transform_preds(data_test)
```

```{r}
#log-transform responses (all are strictly positive)
cleaned_data_train <- cleaned_data_train |>
  mutate(
    log_mean = log(mean),
    log_sd   = log(sd),
    log_skew = log(skew),
    log_kurt = log(kurt)
  )
```

```{r}
#before/after histograms
resp_long <- cleaned_data_train |>
  select(mean, sd, skew, kurt, log_mean, log_sd, log_skew, log_kurt) |>
  pivot_longer(everything()) |>
  mutate(scale = if_else(str_starts(name, "log_"), "log", "raw"),
         stat  = str_remove(name, "log_"))

ggplot(resp_long, aes(value)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  facet_wrap(scale ~ stat, scales = "free", nrow = 2) +
  labs(title = "Response distributions: raw vs. log scale")
```
